verdict.rationale: Docs show scalable ingestion (raw content, connectors with real-time webhooks, customId-based incremental updates) but memories are described as 'embedded and immediately searchable,' implying synchronous processing rather than an explicit async/batch job model. No endpoint or documentation for checking the status of background memory operations is present anywhere in the pack. missing for 10: batch ingestion API docs, async job submission endpoint, job/status polling API, evidence of large-scale throughput guarantees.
